items.headline: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery
items.summary: Satellite images showed a large smoke cloud over the oil facility; overnight, an explosion rocked Sanaa and missiles were intercepted over Riyadh.

items.headline: At least 30 killed in Egypt vehicle fire
items.summary: Egypt's health ministry said the fire broke out in the Imbaba district of Giza.

items.headline: Netanyahu says corruption trial 'must end' as court suggests dropping case
items.summary: Israel's caretaker prime minister spoke in the Knesset after the court raised the idea of ending the case.

items.headline: FTSE 100 slips as US inflation and tariffs weigh
items.summary: The index fell 0.4% to 10,426.94 on Wednesday, and the FTSE 250 lost 0.9% to 23,637.00.

items.headline: Defensive shares cushion London's fall
items.summary: Imperial Brands, Unilever and GSK helped limit losses as technology-linked shares weakened.

items.headline: Hot US inflation raises costs of AI build-out, analyst warns
items.summary: XTB's Kathleen Brooks said the data points to longer high US interest rates, making AI infrastructure dearer to fund.

items.headline: Anthropic study finds AI adoption stalls inside companies
items.summary: Across almost 300 deployments at 58 US firms, 55% raised output or quality but 19% have delivered no business value yet.

items.headline: AI agents now run some of DeepMind's Gemini experiments
items.summary: Research VP Koray Kavukcuoglu said agents control part of the lab's compute, though full self-improvement is still far off.

items.headline: Great Ormond Street trials AI agents for admin work
items.summary: The London children's hospital has started a 15-month programme to deploy agentic AI safely for administrative tasks.
